review.evidence: Issue #509 clearly documents the bug with a reproducible example showing Julia returns 23 while R returns 22 for the same logistic regression model. The fix modifies `dof_residual` to condition on `dispersion_parameter`. PR #560 confirms an existing test had a wrong reference value, which was corrected. Two production files are changed (src/glmfit.jl, src/linpred.jl) and test file is updated.

review.summary: Fix for incorrect `dof_residual` computation for GLM families without a dispersion parameter (Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson). The result was off by 1 compared to R and Stata, caused by unconditionally adding 1 back in `dof_residual` when it should only do so for families with a dispersion parameter.
review.validation_risks: The fix touches `dof_residual` which could affect downstream calculations, but issue author notes vcov is not affected. The `dof` function definition in linpred.jl may also have been adjusted, which could have broader implications.
